value: ARCHITECTURE DECISION: Query layer uses named functions + private filter helpers, NOT a query builder class or repository/facade pattern. Explicit db injection, no singleton wrapping. Decided in GH#30, implemented as human-hum-a8j. The two-function split in filter.ts (buildFilterConditions + addArtistCondition) is the only legit pain point — merging them is OK, but no deeper abstraction.

ARCHITECTURE DECISION: recordListen() is a stable low-level primitive. importScrobbles() is a separate orchestration layer on top. They are intentionally separate — do NOT merge them. SourceFetcher interface was extracted in iteration 15 (GH#29, human-hum-207) to support future Spotify/Tidal sources. Decided in GH#18 + GH#29.

ARCHITECTURE DECISION: Web pages call db + query functions directly — no data access facade, no repository layer. This is intentional for the current single-user prototype. A user-scoped wrapper is planned for Phase 6 (auth/multi-user), not before. Decided in GH#19 + GH#30.

ARCHITECTURE SKILL GUARDRAIL: Before proposing refactors, check GH issues (especially closed RFCs) and beads memories for prior decisions. The PRD decisions log in GH#1 was stress-tested and should not be revisited without good reason. Key rejected patterns: repository/facade, query builder class, merging ingestion+orchestration, premature auth/caching layers.
